hypothesis: Keeping the source stand actor for stand/start while giving Phase9 f005 authority only after the matched stop transition can improve recovery without damaging startup.
intervention: In curriculum_then_policy only, route the post-transition policy slot and previous/issued action handoff through stop_policy_slot(recovery_model).
control: moving=Stage306, stationary=source stand i150, recovery=source stand i150, repeats=5
candidate: moving=Stage306, stationary=source stand i150, recovery=Phase9 f005 u5, repeats=5

historical_source_reproducibility.boundary: Phase13 and later evolved the live adapter/handoff sources. Phase11 results remain bound to the historical digests in this report and runner; the current sources must not be substituted or described as exact reproductions.

official_gate.contract: Phase9 matched-event, stiff=1.2, fixed upper, 5.2 s move, 8.0 s curriculum stop, 2.0 s transition

result: The role repair is correct, but f005 does not pass recovery: both groups fall during stop. Candidate stop drift is 9.1% lower and mean stop pitch is 0.044 rad less negative, but settle time is 18.3% longer and stop/full remain 0/5.
causal_limit: Pre-handoff startup/move differences cannot be caused by the recovery actor and expose run-to-run simulator variability; they are not credited to f005.
next: Do not extend f005 training. Localize the first post-handoff divergence/fall field from the existing traces before proposing a new recovery objective or handoff state distribution.
